name: keel-kg-mcp
description: Knowledge graph business context & requirements MCP server

tools.name: search_business_context
tools.description: Search domain knowledge and business requirements related to the query. Use this when you need to understand business rules, domain concepts, or requirements while writing or reviewing code.

query.description: What to search for (e.g. 'patient eligibility rules', 'care plan requirements')

project.description: Optional project name to scope results

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Get a high-level overview of a project's business domain and requirements. Use this when starting work on a project or when you need to understand its scope, key entities, and domain model before writing code.

tools.name: query_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Query the knowledge graph for entities, relationships, and structured data. Use this for targeted queries when you need specific information from the knowledge graph. Supports natural language (via LightRAG) or Cypher queries (via Neo4j).

query.description: Query text. For Neo4j with format='cypher', use Cypher syntax.

tools.name: get_entity_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific business entity. Returns the entity's properties, type, and all its relationships to other entities.

entity_name.description: Name of the entity (e.g. 'Patient', 'Care Plan', 'Eligibility Check')

tools.name: query_domain_context
tools.description: Query business context for a specific domain. Returns domain knowledge including SLAs, integration specs, security policies, and performance requirements.

tools.name: get_domain_slas
tools.description: Get SLA requirements for a specific domain. Returns response time, availability, throughput, and other SLA targets that code must satisfy.

tools.name: get_domain_integrations
tools.description: Get integration specifications for a specific domain. Returns API endpoints, authentication methods, data formats, and integration patterns required by the domain.

tools.name: get_domain_security_policies
tools.description: Get security and compliance policies for a specific domain. Returns compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC2), encryption policies, access control rules, and audit requirements.

tools.name: list_knowledge_projects
tools.description: List all available knowledge base projects and their registered sources. Shows what knowledge is available for querying.

tools.name: register_knowledge_source
tools.description: How to register a knowledge source for the knowledge graph. Provides instructions for using the KEEL CLI to register document or Confluence sources.

tools.name: ingest_knowledge_source
tools.description: Ingest a registered knowledge source into the knowledge graph. Reads documents or Confluence pages from the registered source and indexes them for search and querying.

name.description: Name of the registered source to ingest

extract_entities.description: Whether to use AI to extract entities and relationships

resources.description: Current KG MCP Server configuration (without secrets)
List of all registered knowledge sources

neo4j.description: Neo4j graph database for structured entity relationships

lightrag.description: LightRAG service for semantic search and RAG queries

confluence.description: Confluence REST API for ingesting wiki pages

devin_cloud_config.instructions: This MCP server provides access to domain knowledge, business requirements, and project context from the KEEL Knowledge Graph. Use these tools to understand business rules, search requirements, and explore domain entities when writing or reviewing code.
